title: A Large-Scale Simulation on Large Language Models for Decision-Making in Political Science

bias_targets.methodology: Quantified using a custom Bias Metric (BM) that measures the systematic difference between LLM-predicted voting proportions and actual election outcomes, identifying consistent skew toward a specific political party (e.g., Democratic or Republican).

Evaluated by comparing LLM-simulated voting preferences across specific demographic dimensions (gender, race/ethnicity, age, and education) against real-world human survey data to identify the exaggeration or overamplification of group-level voting stereotypes.
